positions.title: Senior React Engineer
positions.description:
Resident React expert. Responsible for all React projects. Helped develop patterns and best practices approved by the React community to streamline development

Maintained and developed new features for mobile app made with React Native
Used Google Apigee to build APIs, both for React and Drupal work
Languages/frameworks/tools: NodeJS, NPM, Javascript, ReactJS, MySQL, Docker, CSS, HTML, ZeroMQ, Git, PHP, Drupal, APIs, Apigee

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
MERN developer. Built various products with the noble goal of improving peoples’ lives by changing the way they eat and the way they think about food. Helped rebuilt primary product on Node-based frontend stack shortly after joining. Started with a focus on frontend but role expanded to include full stack, devops, and sysadmin work. Interviewed and onboarded new developers.

Implemented new design of main product with Foundation 5 SCSS framework
Lead development of new frontend stack using Node, Gulp, ReactJS, HapiJS
Worked with designers and PMs to develop/improve UI/UX of various products, some of which include an app to track grocery store deals and items (smart shopping list), an app to create personal goals and track their progress, and improving usability of main product (i.e. adding social social features, improving presentation of meal information, and accessibility features)
Worked directly with CEO to build app to track and recommend fitness classes to users in 1 week as part of an initiative to secure funding
HIPAA trained for confidentiality of Personally Identifiable Health Information
Promoted from Software Engineer to Sr Software Engineer after 9 months (July 2015)
Languages/frameworks/tools: AWS, MongoDB, NodeJS, Javascript, ReactJS, Express, HapiJS, MySQL, Docker, Python, unix, CSS, HTML, ZeroMQ, Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Implemented new design for main web product in first month. Work with designers and product managers to develop new product features. Primarily front end work with some API development on a NodeJS-powered backend

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
UI developer for app made for use in the home automation industry. Built FE stack using Angular, Grunt, and Node. Developed UX for a range of products. Position was mostly remote with occasional office days.

Built new FE stack - Grunt and AngularJS 1.x on the frontend, driven by an Express server which communicated with the Python-Flask RPC server and MongoDB
Developed UI/UX of home automation related applications, including a security camera browser, a tool for tracking property information, and a smart checklist app (for use by property managers)
Gave on-site direction and assistance for app use and setup, troubleshooting
Primary languages/tools: Javascript, NodeJS, Express, AngularJS 1.X, Python, Flask, MongoDB HTML5, CSS/SASS, MySQL, ZeroMQ, Jenkins, Git

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Implementing the UI/UX of new websites. Helped architect internal CSS framework used across the Curse Network sites. Worked with other department leads to create and improve a variety of core products

Designed and developed app used internally to formalize and track requests to the my team for various design assets and FE work. Replaced inefficient reliance on email and improved communication and output of all departments. App continued to be used for 1+ years after departure
Implemented new ad-delivery techniques to help secure partnerships
Redesigned or built from scratch the UI over 20+ websites
Primary languages/tools: HTML5, CSS/SASS, Javascript, jQuery, PHP, MySQL, Mercurial

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description: Primary roles were site build-out and back-end development on the custom CMS framework used by BWM using a combination of HTML/CSS/JS/PHP/MySQL. Occasionally had to collaborate directly with clients to bring individual projects to full spec.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Created and updated Bookstore websites and web pages.

Developed web applications for Bookstore promotions and contests. (For example, the Bookstore had a 24-hour film competition and I developed the site where students could register their teams and submit information about their films and, later, where users could watch all the films and vote for their favorite, all using the school's authentication system).

Worked with Bookstore designers to ensure a consistent design across Bookstore advertising, both in print and web

positions.title: Junior Programmer
positions.description:
jQuery/AJAX. UI development on B2B social platform using web front end technologies.

Implemented custom CRM on a LAMP stack
